description: A Pomodoro timer for engineers that estimates brain fatigue — 30-minute focus sessions, statistics, and fatigue insights
config.longBreakInterval: Number of sessions before a long break
config.autoStartBreak: Automatically start a break after work ends
config.autoStartWork: Automatically start the next session after a break ends
config.focusDoNotDisturb: Automatically suppress VS Code notifications (toasts from other extensions, etc.) during work sessions (Do Not Disturb). Turned off automatically on break or finish.
config.slackIntegration: Put Slack into focus mode (snooze notifications) during work sessions. Turned off automatically on break or finish. Set your token first with "BrainSync: Connect Slack".
config.slackSetStatus: When Slack integration is enabled, also set your Slack status automatically during work sessions.
config.slackStatusText: Slack status text to set during work sessions (Slack shows the end time automatically).
config.slackStatusEmoji: Slack status emoji code to set during work sessions (e.g. :tomato:).
config.fatigueForecastEnabled: Show a brain fatigue forecast (warn before you reach the alert threshold)
config.fatigueForecastLookahead: How many sessions ahead to look when warning (1-4)
